# AlignmentAnchor { #timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentAnchor }

```python
alignment.AlignmentAnchor()
```

A coordinate pair associating one coordinate on timeline A with one
coordinate on timeline B.

A neutral record with no claim semantics. AlignmentAnchors are value
objects: two anchors with the same coordinates and timeline IDs are
equivalent regardless of how they were created.

Only synchronous `MatchClaim` instances produce AlignmentAnchors.
Non-synchronous claims (conceptual matches, NOMATCH) have no anchors.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name          | Type                                        | Description                          |
|---------------|---------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------|
| timeline_a_id | [str](`str`)                                | First timeline's unique identifier.  |
| coordinate_a  | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | Coordinate in first timeline.        |
| timeline_b_id | [str](`str`)                                | Second timeline's unique identifier. |
| coordinate_b  | [Coordinate](`timetoalign.core.Coordinate`) | Coordinate in second timeline.       |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> anchor = AlignmentAnchor(
...     timeline_a_id="score:1",
...     coordinate_a=Coordinate(100.0, TimeUnit.quarters),
...     timeline_b_id="recording:1",
...     coordinate_b=Coordinate(45.5, TimeUnit.seconds),
... )
>>> anchor.get_coordinate_for("score:1")
Coordinate(100.0, quarters)
```

### connects { #timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentAnchor.connects }

```python
alignment.AlignmentAnchor.connects(timeline_id)
```

Check if this anchor connects to a specific timeline.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type         | Description            | Default    |
|-------------|--------------|------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`) | The timeline to check. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                |
|--------|----------------|--------------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if the anchor involves this timeline. |

### connects_both { #timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentAnchor.connects_both }

```python
alignment.AlignmentAnchor.connects_both(timeline_a_id, timeline_b_id)
```

Check if this anchor connects two specific timelines.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type         | Description      | Default    |
|---------------|--------------|------------------|------------|
| timeline_a_id | [str](`str`) | First timeline.  | _required_ |
| timeline_b_id | [str](`str`) | Second timeline. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                              |
|--------|----------------|----------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if the anchor connects exactly these two timelines. |
